Percussive design bed built from first principles: one plate impact per cut on the 12-beat grid, misregister ticks, roller whooshes, a 1.25s riser into the lockup, four assembly hits, and a sub-bass floor. Seeded RNG so the render is reproducible.

metadata.tooling_gap_note: The registry has no image-processing tool (crop / duotone / halftone) — only color_grade, which is an ffmpeg video filter. The plate derivation therefore runs as a project-local script under projects/<id>/scripts/, recorded here with full provenance rather than routed through a tool that does not exist.
